title: FormBuilder
wrapsNative: MonarchTabs for Build and Preview, MonarchMenu for the field palette and MonarchBottomSheet for field settings, around MonarchReorderableList and MonarchFieldRenderer
summary: A recipe, not a component: a form builder on a phone, with Build and Preview tabs, an Add a field menu, a reorderable list of fields, a settings sheet per field and a live preview rendered by MonarchFieldRenderer.
whenToUse: When people design their own forms in an app (intake, surveys, request forms) and the questions are stored as MonarchFormFieldDefinition data.
whenNotToUse: To fill in a form, render it with MonarchFieldRenderer alone. For a fixed form the app defines, use MonarchFormField and the form controls directly.
api: PrimaryTabRow(selectedTabIndex = tab) { Tab(selected = tab == 0, onClick = { tab = 0 }, text = { Text("Build") }); Tab(…) }
DropdownMenu(expanded = paletteOpen, onDismissRequest = …) { DropdownMenuItem(text = { Text(type) }, onClick = { fields += MonarchFormFieldDefinition(…) }) }
MonarchReorderableList(items = fields, key = { it.id }, itemLabel = { it.label }, onReorder = { from, to -> fields.add(to, fields.removeAt(from)) }) { field, _ -> … }
MonarchFieldRenderer(field = field, value = answers[field.id], onValueChange = { answers[field.id] = it })

options.name: fields
options.description: The form, owned by the app as a snapshot list; the same data MonarchFieldRenderer renders and the app stores.

options.name: palette
options.description: The field types the builder offers, with their names; the Add a field menu and the Type select use it.

options.name: settings
options.description: The settings sheet of one field: question, type, required, and any type-specific settings (options, limits) the app supports.

options.name: preview
options.description: MonarchFieldRenderer for every visible field, with answers kept in a state map so conditions can be tried.

states.name: build
states.description: The Add a field button, then the fields in a reorderable list, each with its type, a required mark and an Edit button.

states.name: empty
states.description: MonarchEmptyState says there are no fields yet.

states.name: editing
states.description: A bottom sheet with the question, the type, Required, Remove field and Done. A blank question shows an error.

states.name: preview
states.description: The form as people will fill it in, rendered by MonarchFieldRenderer.

appearance: Material 3 tabs, menu and bottom sheet in the Monarch theme around Monarch rows, fields and buttons. Light, dark and both high-contrast themes follow from those components.
platformNotes: The web FormBuilder is one component with three columns on wide screens (palette, field list, settings) and two or one on smaller ones; a phone has no room for side-by-side panes, so Build and Preview are tabs, the palette is a MonarchMenu behind Add a field and each field's settings open in a MonarchBottomSheet. The parts already exist as Monarch components, so Android keeps it a recipe. The web's condition editor, duplicate, undo after remove, maximum field count and the full per-type settings (options, limits, accepted files) are not in the recipe: the app adds the settings it supports to the sheet, and MonarchConditionEditor for logic. Reordering is MonarchReorderableList: drag the handle, or use its TalkBack actions Move up and Move down. MonarchFormFieldDefinition is a class, not a data class, so the recipe rebuilds a definition to change it. iOS has the same recipe coverage.
accessibility: Build and Preview are Material 3 tabs with the selected state.
Each field row has MonarchReorderableList's drag handle, named Reorder and the field's question, with the TalkBack actions Move up and Move down as the drag equivalent; moves are announced.
Each Edit button is named Edit and the question, so the buttons can be told apart.
The type and required mark are text under the question, not color.
Settings controls are labelled Monarch fields; a blank question is an error on the field.
The preview is the real form, with MonarchFieldRenderer's labels, required marks and errors.
edgeCases: The reorderable list is lazy, so give it a bounded height (heightIn max) when the screen scrolls, or make it the screen's scrolling list.
Removing the field that is being edited closes the sheet.
Changing the type keeps the question; settings that belong to the old type are dropped by the app.

examples.setupTemplate:
val fields = remember {
    mutableStateListOf(
        MonarchFormFieldDefinition({{fields.0.id}}, MonarchFormFieldType.{{fields.0.type|pascal}}, {{fields.0.label}}),
        MonarchFormFieldDefinition(
            {{fields.1.id}},
            MonarchFormFieldType.{{fields.1.type|pascal}},
            {{fields.1.label}},
            required = {{fields.1.required}},
            options = listOf(
                MonarchFormFieldOption({{fields.1.options.0.value}}, {{fields.1.options.0.label}}),
                MonarchFormFieldOption({{fields.1.options.1.value}}, {{fields.1.options.1.label}}),
            ),
        ),
        MonarchFormFieldDefinition(
            {{fields.2.id}},
            MonarchFormFieldType.{{fields.2.type|pascal}},
            {{fields.2.label}},
            conditions = listOf(MonarchCondition({{fields.2.condition.id}}, {{fields.2.condition.field}}, MonarchConditionOperator.Eq, MonarchConditionValue.Text({{fields.2.condition.value}}))),
        ),
        MonarchFormFieldDefinition({{fields.3.id}}, MonarchFormFieldType.{{fields.3.type|pascal}}, {{fields.3.label}}),
    )
}
val typeLabels = mapOf(
    MonarchFormFieldType.{{palette.0.type|pascal}} to {{palette.0.label}},
    MonarchFormFieldType.{{palette.1.type|pascal}} to {{palette.1.label}},
    MonarchFormFieldType.{{palette.2.type|pascal}} to {{palette.2.label}},
    MonarchFormFieldType.{{palette.3.type|pascal}} to {{palette.3.label}},
    MonarchFormFieldType.Email to "Email",

    MonarchFormFieldType.Number to "Number",
    MonarchFormFieldType.Date to "Date",
    MonarchFormFieldType.Time to "Time",
    MonarchFormFieldType.Consent to "Consent",

fun MonarchFormFieldDefinition.edited(
    id: String = this.id,
    label: String = this.label,
    description: String? = this.description,
    type: MonarchFormFieldType = this.type,
    required: Boolean = this.required,
) = MonarchFormFieldDefinition(id, type, label, description = description, required = required, options = options, conditions = conditions)
var tab by rememberSaveable { mutableIntStateOf(0) }
var editing by remember { mutableStateOf<String?>({{fields.0.id}}) }
var added by rememberSaveable { mutableIntStateOf(0) }
val answers = remember { mutableStateMapOf<String, MonarchFormFieldValue?>() }
